rows.title_short: Rationalizing The Percentage Of Sales Allocation Taxable By The City Or Municipality Where Factories, Project Offices, Plants And Plantations Are Located In The Pursuit Of Their Businesses
rows.abstract: Seeks to adjust the local government tax rate, to wit:  a) on sales recorded in the principal office of manufacturers, assemblers, contractors, producers and exporters with factories, project offices, plants and plantations taxable by the city/municipality where the principal office is located - from 30% to 20% in the first year and 10% thereafter; and b) on sales recorded in the principal office taxable by the city/municipality where the factory, project or plantation is located  - from 70% to 80% on the first year and 90% thereafter.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2008-10-10
